name: SS J.R. Thompson
about: SS J.R. Thompson (2018-046A), a crewed vehicle (Cygnus), launched 2018 May 21. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (GRP).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2018 May 24), held fixed
docked to A06499; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
